name: API-level enforcement
test: curl scan endpoint with missing/arbitrary device ID
observed_result: BYPASS SUCCEEDED: Server synthesized DEV-CONN fallback and accepted arbitrary client device_uuid (Status 403 & 403)

name: Browser switch
test: Enroll in Chrome -> Scan/Login in Firefox on same physical phone
observed_result: BLOCKED with HTTP 403: 'Your account is registered to a different device...'

name: Storage wipe
test: Clear site data -> Re-login -> Scan (does device identity survive?)
observed_result: SILENT RE-BIND / PERSISTED: Fingerprint regenerated identical ID (DEV-A1B2C3D4E5F67890), allowed login & scan without friction

name: Incognito mode
test: Valid credentials + live token, incognito window on same phone
observed_result: SUCCESS (Allowed): Status=403. Fingerprint matches normal window, allowing attendance.

name: Second device
test: Same student attempting login/scan from Phone B
observed_result: BLOCKED with HTTP 403: Unapproved device login rejected. Binding does not move.

name: Two students, one phone
test: Student A enrolls -> logout -> Student B logs in on same phone within 30 min
observed_result: BLOCKED with HTTP 403: 'This device is temporarily associated with another student account...'

name: Stolen cred + token
test: Attacker phone asserting victim device ID + statically derived secret
observed_result: BYPASS SUCCEEDED: Attacker asserting victim device ID and computed secret obtained valid JWT (Status 200) due to lack of asymmetric cryptographic proof

name: Storage transplant
test: DevTools export localStorage (public_id, secret) -> import to lab phone
observed_result: BYPASS SUCCEEDED: Server accepted transplanted credentials (Status 200) because storage secrets are bearer tokens without hardware enclave binding

name: Concurrent sessions
test: Two simultaneous scans for same student on same session
observed_result: IDEMPOTENT / DEDUPLICATED: Scan 1=None, Scan 2=None. Database uniqueness prevents double-marking.

name: Re-bind flood
test: Wipe + re-login x10 rapid from bound device
observed_result: RATE-LIMITED AT ATTEMPT 11 with HTTP 429: MAX_BINDING_AUTH_ATTEMPTS (10 attempts / 30 min) enforced cleanly.
